text_blocks.snippet: One key reason exercise might decrease breast cancer risk is its ability to help manage weight and body fat, which in turn can lower levels of estrogen and other hormones that can promote breast cancer cell growth. Additionally, exercise can boost the immune system and reduce inflammation, both of which play a role in cancer prevention.

list.snippet: Exercise helps control weight, and being overweight or obese is a known risk factor for breast cancer. By helping to reduce body fat, exercise can lower these hormone levels and potentially reduce breast cancer risk.
